text: 🇲🇽✊ La Pastora: 11,000 women treated in 200 days, 92% within guaranteed times. "Health is a right, and when we treat breast cancer we do it with a time guarantee." — Alejandro Svarch, IMSS-Bienestar director, Mañanera, Oct 20, 2026 The IMSS-Bienestar women's cancer hospital in Mexico City posts its deadlines in the lobby: biopsy the same day, pathology within 14 days, treatment within 30. The international norm is over 40. In 200 days: more than 800 cancer surgeries, 9,000 specialist consultations, 2,800 oncology emergencies and 1,000 chemotherapy sessions, all free. It turns no one away: 35% of patients come from other states, and about half have social security. The building had been abandoned for years until Sheinbaum, as mayor, rebuilt it for COVID. The model will reach every state: 10 more centers in 2027, 11 in 2028 and 10 in 2029.

🇲🇽🏭 <u>Ebrard Purges 1,000+ Asian Steel Suppliers Whose Plants Didn't Exist</u>

Mexico's Economy Ministry sent inspectors to Asia to check the mills named on importers' steel-origin certificates, then struck more than 1,000 supplier registrations because the plants weren't there, El Financiero reports. "We went to verify it in Asia and we withdrew more than a thousand," said Marcelo Ebrard, who rejects the US claim that Mexico is a steel triangulation route.

🚨🇲🇽 <u>CNDH: Infiltrators at Guadalajara Water March Were Coordinated With Lemus's Police</u>

Mexico's National Human Rights Commission found that the people identified as infiltrators at the October 11 clean-water march in Guadalajara were coordinated "directly with the authorities," even though Jalisco's government had claimed they had nothing to do with the police operation. The commission also says Jalisco's state rights body ignored its requests for five days. Governor Pablo Lemus blames "political interests."
banner: CNDH: JALISCO INFILTRATORS TIED TO POLICE

🔥🇲🇽 <u>Her Ex-Prosecutor Sits in Altiplano. Maru Campos Says Her Prosecutor's Office Did Its Job</u>

Chihuahua's PAN governor Maru Campos released a video defending the state Fiscalía after the arrest of her own former prosecutor, César Jáuregui, over US agents taking part in the April operation at El Pinal. The state case is for common-law crimes; the FGR is running its own separate case against him. Campos's line: the process now belongs to the judges.

🇲🇽🎓 <u>19.6 Million Students on Bienestar Scholarships</u>

Mexico's Becas para el Bienestar now reach 19,593,156 students, an investment of more than 136 billion pesos, scholarships coordinator Julio César León Trujillo reported at the mañanera. Basic education: 14.96 million kids. High school: 4.16 million. University (Jóvenes Escribiendo el Futuro): 414,100. The goal is 22 million by the end of 2026.

🇲🇽🏥 <u>La Pastora: 11,000 Women Treated for Cancer in 200 Days</u>

Mexico City's public cancer hospital for women, run by IMSS-Bienestar, has seen more than 11,000 patients and performed over 800 cancer surgeries in its first 200 days, with 92% of care delivered on schedule. The rule: biopsy results within 14 days, treatment started within 30. Sheinbaum wants the model in all 32 states. Free, public and on time.

🇲🇽🇨🇺 <u>Sheinbaum on Washington's Charges Against Raúl Castro: It's About November</u>

Florida prosecutors want a 95-year-old Raúl Castro arrested over the 1996 Brothers to the Rescue shootdown, three decades later and two weeks before the US midterms. President Sheinbaum didn't play along: the charges are "a political matter" tied to the November election, she said from Palacio Nacional. A thirty-year-old case, revived right when Florida votes are up for grabs.
banner: CUBA: CASTRO CHARGES ARE ELECTION POLITICS

text:
🇲🇽🏠 <u>Infonavit and Fovissste Outlend the Banks for the First Time in Two Years</u>

Public housing institutes placed 137.5 billion pesos in home-purchase loans in the first half of 2026, up 5.1% in real terms. Commercial banks fell 4.8% to 112 billion. Loan counts went the same way: the institutes rose to 181,100 while banks dropped to 43,500. "For the first time in 24 months, the amount placed by the public institutes is greater than commercial banking," said BBVA Research's Marissa González, per El Economista. The average public loan rose to 760,000 pesos.
banner: HOME LOANS: INFONAVIT BEATS THE BANKS

🚨🇲🇽 <u>800 Cartel Recruitment Accounts Taken Down, 1,000 More in the Pipeline</u>

Mexico's Security Cabinet has identified 1,800 social media pages that criminal groups use to recruit young people. About 800 are already down, mostly on TikTok, and the remaining thousand are being processed. The National Intelligence Center's cybersecurity unit monitors social networks and video game platforms, and three alleged recruiters were arrested over the weekend. Teens forced into crime can be treated as victims, not criminals.

🔥🇲🇽 <u>UIF and SAT Open Files on Every Morena Candidate for Governor</u>

On presidential instructions, Mexico's Financial Intelligence Unit and the SAT opened files on all Morena coordinators aiming for the 17 governorships in 2027. Investigators are checking their assets, properties and bank accounts, along with those of spouses and adult children, so that dirty money from corruption or organized crime doesn't fund campaigns. Contralínea's Miguel Badillo reports that one of the files belongs to Santiago Nieto, the former UIF chief and now Morena's coordinator in Querétaro. Lines of inquiry in his case include links to invoice mills (EFOS) and alleged illicit enrichment.
banner: UIF AUDITS ALL MORENA GOVERNOR HOPEFULS
